headword: {通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん}

definitions.explanation: A restriction on data speed or usage imposed by mobile carriers when a user exceeds their monthly data allowance.

examples.japanese: {通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I always get throttled at the end of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧すぎて{通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ひっかかった。
examples.english: I watched too many videos and got data throttled.

notes:
{通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん} typically reduces speeds to 128kbps or lower once you exceed your data plan limit. Users often try to avoid this by using Wi-Fi or purchasing additional data.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (to get data throttled)
- {通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}する→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧ (to remove data throttling)
- {通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (currently throttled)
